name: Impetus of Artemis
description:
• Double sneaking calls or dismisses your chosen [effect:spiritmount][aqua]spirit mount[/aqua][/effect], defaulting to your [effect:spiritwolf][aqua]spirit wolf[/aqua][/effect].

  • While mounted, you apply [gradient:pink:white]mo[/gradient][gradient:white:purple]on[/gradient][gradient:purple:white]lig[/gradient][gradient:white:pink]ht[/gradient] to the closest enemy. [gradient:pink:white]Mo[/gradient][gradient:white:purple]on[/gradient][gradient:purple:white]lit[/gradient] enemies periodically glow, take [effect:hearts][dark-gray]+2-4♥️[/dark-gray][/effect] magic damage from headshots, and ranged kills collect their loot and heal your mount 1♥️.

[dark-gray]"Let moonlight carry you on your midnight hunt."[/dark-gray]

effects.explanation: Shoot an owned mount to mark it as your spirit. While it's called, shooting it unmarks it and shooting a different mount makes it your new spirit mount. If your spirit mount is killed, it can be called again after one Minecraft day.
A large, mountable wolf tamed to you. Shooting your spirit wolf changes its coat.
2❤️ normally, increased to 4❤️ during a full moon.
